package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"slices"
)

func main() {
	in := bufio.NewReaderSize(os.Stdin, 1<<16)
	var n int
	fmt.Fscan(in, &n)
	a := make([]int64, n)
	for i := range a {
		fmt.Fscan(in, &a[i])
	}
	slices.Sort(a)
	var total int64
	count := 0
	for i := n - 1; i >= 0; i-- { // largest first
		if total+a[i] <= 0 { // every remaining value is no larger
			break
		}
		total += a[i]
		count++
	}
	fmt.Println(count)
}
